newsitem.title: SWEDEN: PLM to invest $125 mln in Russian plant.
newsitem.headline: PLM to invest $125 mln in Russian plant.

text.p: Swedish drinks packaging company PLM AB said on Thursday it was in a joint venture investing $125 million in an aluminum can producing plant in Russia.
The new plant, which would be located at Naro Fominsk, 70 km southwest of Moscow, would have an annual capacity of 1.75 billion cans when it was working at full capacity, PLM said in a statement.
PLM said the first of two production lines would be operating in the autumn of 1998 and the second at the start of 1999.
PLM said it was the majority owner of the joint venture company, ZAO PLM Beverage Can Manufacturing.

The other owners are the U.S. Ball Corp, Swedefund International AB, Danish Investment Fund for Central and Eastern Europe, International Finance Corp and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development.
